prompt.es: Ante el horno de fuego los tres hebreos dijeron que Dios podía librarlos: "Y ____, sepas, oh rey, que no serviremos a tus dioses" (Daniel 3:18).

prompt.sw: Mbele ya tanuru ya moto Waebrania wale watatu walisema Mungu aweza kuwaokoa, "Bali ____, ujue, Ee mfalme, ya kuwa sisi hatutaitumikia miungu yako" (Danieli 3:18).
prompt.pt: Diante da fornalha ardente, os três hebreus disseram que Deus podia livrá-los: “E, ____, fica sabendo, ó rei, que não serviremos a teus deuses” (Daniel 3:18).

prompt.en: The handwriting on Belshazzar's wall meant: "You have been weighed in the ____ and found wanting" (Daniel 5:27).

prompt.en: Before the Sanhedrin Jesus answered from Daniel 7: "You will see the ____ sitting at the right hand of the Power, and coming with the clouds of heaven" (Mark 14:62).

prompt.sw: Mbele ya Baraza Kuu Yesu alijibu kutoka Danieli 7: "mtamwona ____ ameketi mkono wa kuume wa Nguvu, akija pamoja na mawingu ya mbinguni" (Marko 14:62).
prompt.pt: Diante do Sinédrio, Jesus respondeu a partir de Daniel 7: “Vereis o ____ assentado à direita do Todo-poderoso e vindo sobre as nuvens do céu” (Marcos 14:62).

prompt.en: Daniel 9 contains the prophecy of the ____ weeks, which gave Daniel the date of Calvary six centuries in advance.

prompt.sw: Danieli 9 ina unabii wa majuma ____, ambao ulimpa Danieli tarehe ya Kalvari karne sita kabla.
